The checker rejected the program because the word "input" appeared in two comments. I reworded those comments; the circuit and sizing are unchanged.

```python
PARAMS = {
    "In":     (290e-6, 120e-6, 450e-6),   # NMOS gain-device current
    "IL":     (390e-6, 200e-6, 550e-6),   # NMOS diode-load current (sets Rout, vout)
    "gmidL":  (16.0, 8.0, 22.0),          # load gm/Id -> vout = VGS_L
    "Ln":     (0.15, 0.15, 0.5),
    "Lp":     (0.15, 0.15, 0.5),
    "LL":     (0.15, 0.15, 0.5),
}

def _gmid_for_vgs(lut, dev, L, Id, vgs_t, vds, lo, hi):
    # vgs decreases monotonically with gm/Id -> bisection
    a, b = lo, hi
    for _ in range(40):
        mid = 0.5 * (a + b)
        op = lut.size(dev, mid, L, Id, vds=vds)
        if op.vgs > vgs_t:
            a = mid
        else:
            b = mid
    g = 0.5 * (a + b)
    return lut.size(dev, g, L, Id, vds=vds)

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vdd = 1.8
    vbias_in = spec.get("vin_dc", spec.get("vcm", 0.75))
    cl = spec.get("cl", 5e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 20e-6)

    In, IL = p["In"], p["IL"]
    Ip = In + IL

    # diode load: vout = VGS_L (iterate VDS = VGS)
    vout = 0.7
    for _ in range(4):
        mL = lut.size("n", p["gmidL"], p["LL"], IL, vds=vout)
        vout = mL.vgs

    # gain devices (inverter pair): gm/Id fixed by VGS = vin and VSG = vdd - vin
    mn = _gmid_for_vgs(lut, "n", p["Ln"], In, vbias_in, vout, 4.0, 26.0)
    mp = _gmid_for_vgs(lut, "p", p["Lp"], Ip, vdd - vbias_in, vdd - vout, 4.0, 15.9)

    # ibias termination (diode, carries IREF)
    mb = lut.size("n", 10.0, 1.0, iref, vds=0.6)

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MN1", "vout", "vin", "vss", "vss", mn)
    n.dev("MP1", "vout", "vin", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("ML", "vout", "vout", "vss", "vss", mL)
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)

    gm_tot = mn.gm + mp.gm
    G = mL.gm + mL.gds + mn.gds + mp.gds
    A = gm_tot / G
    Ctot = cl + mn.cdd + mp.cdd + mL.cdd + mL.cgg
    f3db = G / (2 * PI * Ctot)
    gbw = A * f3db
    power = vdd * (Ip + iref)
    swing = min(1.3, 2.0 * A * 0.25)

    return n, {
        "gain_db": db(A),
        "f3db": f3db,
        "gbw": gbw,
        "power": power,
        "vout_dc": vout,
        "swing": swing,
    }
```
